description_en: Modifies a firewall rule of a specified simple application server
description_zh: 修改指定轻量应用服务器的防火墙规则
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open modify-firewall-rule --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --rule-id eeea34d9867b4d55a4ff8d5fcfbd0000 --rule-protocol TCP --port 3306 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyFirewallRule

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the specified simple application server
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the specified simple application server. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html to query the list of supported Alibaba Cloud regions
parameters.help_zh:
指定的轻量应用服务器实例所属的地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查看支持的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. A client token is a unique string generated by your client. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The transport-layer protocol. Valid values:

TCP: TCP protocol.
UDP: UDP protocol.
TCP+UDP: TCP and UDP protocols
parameters.help_zh:
传输层协议。取值范围：

TCP：TCP协议。
UDP：UDP协议。
TCP+UDP：TCP和UDP协议
parameters.name: rule_protocol

parameters.help_en: The port range. Valid values of port numbers: 1 to 65535. Separate the start port and end port with a forward slash (/). Example: `1024/1055`, which indicates port range 1024 to 1055
parameters.help_zh: 端口范围。端口的取值范围为1~65535。使用正斜线（/）隔开起始端口和终止端口，例如：`1024/1055`表示端口范围为1024~1055
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The IP address or CIDR block
parameters.name: source_cidr_ip

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the firewall rule
parameters.name: remark
